detailed_descriptions.en: Nothing Strange Here is a cozy mystery adventure where your choices shape the town of Larcenest Gap. Meet quirky locals, take on strange quests , and use your camera to capture memorable moments . Turn those moments into articles that influence how the world reacts with cozy, funny or even mysterious outcomes.. it’s up to you. Uncover hidden secrets , earn achievements and collect stickers. Then build your own scrapbook filled with your own stories . All of this, while investigating a mystery that runs deeper than the headlines. Wander through an open world full of life. Around every corner there are strange sights, and cozy moments waiting to be found. From mysterious forests to quirky city streets, every area in Larcenest Gap is handcrafted for curious players who love to explore, snap photos, and uncover hidden surprises. Something’s off in Larcenest Gap. As the new journalist in town, you’re here to find the truth. Investigate hidden mysteries that go beyond your job description and help the locals solve their bizarre problems. Your choices shape the world you live in. Your choices shape the town. Every quest you complete lets you choose one out of three article styles. The article you publish will change how the world reacts, from the gossip on the town’s quest board to how areas look and feel. The townsfolk remember what you write… and sometimes even dress the part. Turn strange encounters into cozy collectibles. Unlock stickers by photographing weird moments, completing quests, and exploring hidden areas. Use the stickers to decorate your journal to reflect your creativity, turning it into a masterpiece or an evidence board. It’s all up to you! Time passes… and the world changes with it. Explore the world under the warm sun or the eerie glow of moonlight. Certain events, characters, and secrets only appear at specific times, so keep your camera ready and eyes open.
